sources.title: Reflective listening
sources.technique: Reflect both the content and the feeling of what the speaker said, so they can confirm or correct it.

sources.title: Towards Emotional Support Dialog Systems (Liu et al., 2021)
sources.technique: Reflection of feelings is a core comforting strategy: articulate and describe the seeker's feelings.
